introduction: North Mississippi Rural Legal Services assists eligible northern Mississippi residents with civil legal problems. Confirm the office serving your county before requesting intake.
description: North Mississippi Rural Legal Services assists eligible northern Mississippi residents with civil legal problems. Confirm the office serving your county before requesting intake.

sections.who: The provider checks service area, financial eligibility and issue type. Special projects can have different rules.
sections.get: Accepted cases may receive legal advice or representation. The Elder Law Project serves eligible older residents.
sections.docs:
• County and legal issue.
  • Notices and court dates.
  • Income and household details for screening.
sections.apply:
1. Locate the provider

    Use LSC’s legal-aid locator.

  2. Confirm intake details

    Ask the serving office for its current intake number, hours and application route.

  3. Explain urgent dates

    Have relevant notices available and follow document instructions.
sections.after: A request does not suspend court deadlines or guarantee representation.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using NMRLS program overview; LSC provider locator. Some current details still need confirmation; contact the program before relying on them.

faqs: Does the organization serve all Mississippi counties?
Confirm its northern service area for your county.
Can older residents ask about special help?
Ask about the Elder Law Project.
Are published older hotline hours reliable?
Confirm current intake details with the office.
